name: Sanathana Dharma Charitable Trust
summary: The principal trust. Awards, publications, media, the performing arts, heritage exhibitions and medical camps.
body: Registered on 10 February 2000 with its office at Anandavanam, Bheemunipatnam, the Trust carries the greater part of Guruji's public work — the annual honours, the publication programme, and the medical camps conducted in tribal areas across several Indian states.
Its seven stated objectives are set out in full on the Objectives page.
objectivesIntro: Published by the Trust under the heading “Important Activities of our Trust”.

objectives.title: Recognition of Eminent Citizens
objectives.body: Annual awards honouring eminent citizens of society, presented with a cash award, a citation and a memento at a formal convocation.

objectives.title: Honouring Cultural Contributors
objectives.body: Felicitation of accomplished individuals on the occasion of Sree Ramanavami through the Prathibha Puraskaram.

objectives.title: Publications
objectives.body: Publication of Guruji's writings on ancient history, philosophy and cultural commentary, and support for other authors working in the same field.

objectives.title: Media & Preservation
objectives.body: Television and film work portraying the history and culture of Andhra, including a feature on the Buddha that received a special jury award.

objectives.title: Promotion of the Performing Arts
objectives.body: Sponsoring music academies, conducting annual festivals, establishing free music learning centres, and conferring titles such as Sangeetha Vidya Nidhi.

objectives.title: Heritage Exhibition
objectives.body: Cultural exhibitions of charts and artefacts covering the region's history from prehistoric times to the modern day.

objectives.title: Medical Outreach
objectives.body: Medical camps in tribal areas across several Indian states, providing free medicines and other necessities.

activities.title: Sivananda Eminent Citizen Awards
activities.summary: Annual recognition of eminent citizens, conferred with a cash award, citation and memento at a formal convocation.
body: The awards have been conferred since 1994. The 2022 convocation was held on Sunday 27 March at the Durbar Hall, Raj Bhavan, Chennai.
Sri K. Parasaran, the legal luminary, received the award in 2020.

activities.title: Sree Ramanavami Prathibha Puraskaram
activities.summary: Felicitation of accomplished individuals on the occasion of Sree Ramanavami.
body: Presented each year at Sree Ramanavami, the Prathibha Puraskaram encourages sustained contribution to culture and scholarship.

activities.title: Sree Krishna Janmashtami
activities.summary: The annual Janmashtami observance, with bhajan, discourse and classical music through the evening.
body: The 2026 celebration falls on Friday 4 September, from 6:00 pm at Tivoli Garden, Secunderabad.

name: Siva Ganga Sangeeta Parishad
summary: The music and dance wing — festivals, free learning centres, and the Vidya Nidhi honours.
body: The Parishad promotes classical music and the cultural arts, conducting the Annual Music Festival, the Sarada Sangeetotsavam and the Vaggeyakara Festival, and establishing free music learning centres.
It confers the titles Sangeetha Vidya Nidhi and Natya Vidya Nidhi, and the Sarada Sangeetha Puraskaram.

objectives.title: Promotion of Classical Music
objectives.body: Conducting annual festivals and sponsoring music academies, so that performers and the listening tradition around them are both sustained.

objectives.title: Free Music Learning Centres
objectives.body: Establishing centres at which classical music is taught without fee.

objectives.title: Recognition of Artists
objectives.body: Conferring the titles Sangeetha Vidya Nidhi and Natya Vidya Nidhi, and the Sarada Sangeetha Puraskaram.

activities.title: Annual Music Festival
activities.summary: The Parishad's principal festival of Carnatic vocal and instrumental music.

activities.title: Sarada Sangeetotsavam
activities.summary: Music offered during Sarad Navaratrulu, with the Sarada Sangeetha Puraskaram presented to performing artists.

activities.title: Vaggeyakara Festival
activities.summary: A festival devoted to the composer-poets of the Carnatic tradition.

activities.title: Other Events
activities.summary: Further concerts and gatherings held through the year.

honours.title: Sangeetha Vidya Nidhi
honours.summary: A title conferred on musicians in recognition of accomplishment and standing in the Carnatic tradition.

honours.title: Natya Vidya Nidhi
honours.summary: The corresponding title for dancers, recognising mastery of the classical dance tradition.

honours.title: Sarada Sangeetha Puraskaram
honours.summary: An award presented during the Sarada Sangeetotsavam to artists performing in the festival.

name: Mahalakshmi Temple Charitable Trust
summary: Temple observances through the year, including the Navaratri festivals.
body: The Trust maintains the temple observances, most visibly the Vasantha Navaratrulu in spring and the Sarad Navaratrulu (Daseera) in autumn.

objectives.title: Temple Observance
objectives.body: Maintaining worship and the seasonal festivals at the temple.

objectives.title: The Navaratri Festivals
objectives.body: Keeping Vasantha Navaratrulu in spring and Sarad Navaratrulu (Daseera) in autumn, each over nine nights.

activities.title: Vasantha Navaratrulu
activities.summary: The spring Navaratri observance kept at the temple.

activities.title: Sarad Navaratrulu (Daseera)
activities.summary: The autumn Navaratri observance, during which the Sarada Sangeetotsavam is held.

activities.title: Other Events
activities.summary: Further observances held at the temple through the year.

name: Sivanandaguru Cultural Trust
summary: Gurudham and Saptadham at Warangal, and the observances kept there.
body: Gurudham was built in 1990 near the Ayyappa Temple on Mulug Road, Warangal.

Saptadham — two halls and a high domed cubical structure — was consecrated by Guruji on 12 February 2010, Maha Sivaratri. Guruji asked that it serve as more than a spiritual centre: “This should be utilized as a cultural centre of Hindu dharma.”

objectives.title: A Cultural Centre of Hindu Dharma
objectives.body: Guruji's instruction for Saptadham: “More than a spiritual centre, it should be developed as a cultural Centre.”

objectives.title: A Communication Centre
objectives.body: A place where a visitor staying some days may seek guidance through contemplation and prayer.

objectives.title: Programmes
objectives.body: Music concerts, festivals, religious functions, cultural programmes, seminars, puranasravana, hari katha kaalakshepa and talks on various subjects.

activities.title: Guruji's Birthday
activities.summary: Kept each year in remembrance of Guruji, born 21 December 1928 at Rajahmundry.

activities.title: Maha Sivaratri
activities.summary: Night-long observance in the four jaamas. Saptadham itself was consecrated on Maha Sivaratri in 2010.

activities.title: Guru Poornima Celebrations
activities.summary: Paduka puja and remembrance, followed by annadanam.

activities.title: Other Events
activities.summary: Further gatherings held at Gurudham and Saptadham.
